tools.name: send_kudos
tools.title: Send a kudos
tools.description: Send a kudos (a short public appreciation message) from the account running this tool (in a thread, the digital worker) to a person or a space. Before calling this, check that account still has kudos left by calling get_my_kudos_allowance. Resolve the receiver first: for a person use get_user_by_username to get the exact username, for a space use get_my_spaces to get its pretty name. When the user asks for the kudos to be given to a person *in a space* (for example "send a kudos to John in the Engineering space"), keep receiver_type 'user' and pass that space in space_pretty_name, so the kudos is published in the space stream instead of the receiver's personal stream. It is refused when the receiver is the account running the tool, and publishing in a space requires that account to be a member who can post (a redactor) in that space.

receiver_type.description: Whether the kudos is given to a person ('user') or to a space ('space') (required).

receiver_id.description: The receiver identifier (required): for receiver_type 'user' this is the username (resolve with get_user_by_username); for receiver_type 'space' this is the space pretty name (resolve with get_my_spaces).

message.description: The appreciation message to attach to the kudos (required).

space_pretty_name.description: Pretty name of the space the kudos must be published in (optional, resolve it with get_my_spaces). Use it when the kudos is given to a person but must appear in a space stream; leave it empty to publish the kudos in the receiver's personal stream. When receiver_type is 'space' it is redundant and must either be omitted or be the receiving space itself.

tools.name: send_kudos_on_activity
tools.title: Send a kudos on a post of a space
tools.description: Send a kudos (a short public appreciation message) on a post of a space, identified by its activity id. The kudos is sent by the account running this tool (in a thread, the digital worker) and counts on that account's kudos allowance. It is received by the author of the post (on a post that is itself a kudos, by the receiver of that kudos), never by someone the caller picks, and it is published in the post's space. As to who sends and who receives, it is refused only when the account running the tool is that receiver or has no kudos left: the person who asked for the kudos may well be the post's author. That account must also be able to see the post. The id must be that of a post, not of a comment. The result carries the link to the kudos.

activity_id.description: Identifier of the post of the space to send the kudos on (required). It must be an activity id, not a comment id.

message.description: The appreciation message to attach to the kudos (required).

tools.name: cancel_kudos
tools.title: Cancel a sent kudos
tools.description: Cancel (delete) a kudos that the current user previously sent, identified by its kudos id. Only the sender can cancel their own kudos, and it cannot be cancelled once other kudos are linked to it. Find the kudos id with list_sent_kudos.

kudos_id.description: Technical identifier of the kudos to cancel (required). Obtain it from list_sent_kudos.

tools.name: get_my_kudos_allowance
tools.title: Get my kudos allowance
tools.description: Get how many kudos the current user can still send during the running period, along with the period type (WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER, SEMESTER or YEAR) and its start and end dates. Call this before send_kudos to make sure the user still has kudos left.

tools.name: list_received_kudos
tools.title: List received kudos
tools.description: List the kudos received by a user or a space during a period. If no identity_id is given, it defaults to the current user. Received kudos are public. Use get_my_user_information or search_users to resolve a user's identity id, or get_my_spaces for a space identity id.

identity_id.description: Social identity id of the user or space whose received kudos to list. Defaults to the current user when omitted.

period_type.description: Period to look at. Defaults to the platform's configured kudos period when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of kudos to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: list_sent_kudos
tools.title: List sent kudos
tools.description: List the kudos sent by the current user during a period, with their kudos ids (useful before cancel_kudos). Defaults to the current user; do not use it to browse other users' sent kudos.

identity_id.description: Social identity id of the sender. Defaults to the current user when omitted; keep it omitted in normal use.

period_type.description: Period to look at. Defaults to the platform's configured kudos period when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of kudos to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: list_kudos_on_activity
tools.title: List kudos on an activity
tools.description: List the kudos attached to an activity (or to its comments), identified by the activity id. The current user must be allowed to view the activity (e.g. be a member of its space).

activity_id.description: Identifier of the activity whose kudos to list (required).
